title: Remove wmem_packet_scope()
description: All called have been removed.  Going forward pinfo->pool will have to be used.

changes_data.diff:
@@ -55,8 +55,7 @@ changed without warning.
 
 Dissectors that include the wmem_scopes.h header file will have three pools available
 to them automatically: pinfo->pool, wmem_file_scope() and
-wmem_epan_scope(); there is also a wmem_packet_scope() for cases when the
-`pinfo` argument is not accessible, but pinfo->pool should be preferred.
+wmem_epan_scope().
 
 The pinfo pool is scoped to the dissection of each packet, meaning that any
 memory allocated in it will be automatically freed at the end of the current

@@ -171,9 +171,6 @@ WS_DLL_PUBLIC void col_clear(column_info *cinfo, const int col);
  *
  * Usually used to set const strings!
  *
- * @warning Do *NOT* use with strings allocated with wmem_packet_scope(), as it
- * is freed slightly too early; use the pinfo->pool scope instead.
- *
  * @param cinfo the current packet row
  * @param col the column to use, e.g. COL_INFO
  * @param str the string to set

@@ -27,25 +27,6 @@ WS_DLL_PUBLIC
 wmem_allocator_t *
 wmem_epan_scope(void);
 
-/**
- * @brief Fetch the current packet scope.
- *
- * Allocated memory is freed when wmem_leave_packet_scope() is called, which is normally at the end of packet dissection.
- * N.B. Please use pinfo->pool in new code when possible. See
- * <https://lists.wireshark.org/archives/wireshark-dev/202107/msg00052.html>
- */
-WS_DLL_PUBLIC
-wmem_allocator_t *
-wmem_packet_scope(void);
-
-WS_DLL_LOCAL
-void
-wmem_enter_packet_scope(void);
-
-WS_DLL_LOCAL
-void
-wmem_leave_packet_scope(void);

commits_data.title: Remove wmem_packet_scope()
commits_data.message:
Remove wmem_packet_scope()

All called have been removed.  Going forward pinfo->pool will have to be used.
